punchline: Seven days after the first transistor worked, Bell Labs officials were watching it.
thirty_sec: On 16 December 1947 Bardeen and Brattain got two gold contacts on germanium to amplify a signal; a week later they demonstrated it to Bell Labs officials, and Shockley spent the next weeks improving the idea.
question: What is the roughest version of your idea that already proves it works, and who should see it this week?
key_contrast: Do not wait for polish; show the rough version that works.
